_comment: Update every field below with your brokerage information. This file controls all branding across every quote.
_comment_colors: Hex color codes. brand_navy = company name, section headers. brand_gold = FREIGHT QUOTE label, total amount.
_comment_quote: Default quote validity in days. 14 is standard.
_comment_floor: Your minimum linehaul rate in dollars per mile. Used as a floor when calculating rates from scratch.
_comment_fsc: Set to true to embed fuel surcharge into the flat rate (all-inclusive). Set to false to break it out as a separate line item.
_comment_insurance: Your standard cargo insurance clause. Appears as the final term on every quote. Edit to match your carrier requirements.
cargo_insurance_clause: The carrier selected for this shipment will carry a minimum of $100,000 in cargo insurance. Any cargo value exceeding $100,000 must be disclosed prior to booking. Shipper is responsible for obtaining a shipper's interest insurance policy to cover any value above the carrier's cargo liability limit.
_comment_output: Where PDFs are saved. Defaults to /mnt/user-data/outputs (Claude computer environment). Change to a local path if running outside Claude.
_comment_eia: Optional: Register a free EIA API key at https://www.eia.gov/opendata/register.php for reliable diesel data fetching. Leave blank to use web scraping fallback.
